rubric_items.reason: Every part of ACs 1-4 (label, date/time format, doctor, earliest Scheduled after now, empty state, exclusions, unchanged page) maps to REQ-1..REQ-8. Out of scope items each give a reason.
Most REQs are atomic and testable. REQ-9 combines comparing and displaying in Asia/Kolkata, and REQ-11 does not say which element is the link.
Each known status cites the ticket, the baseline or an IDE answer (A-01, A-02). Nothing is invented. The claimed routes and formatter exist in the generated inventories.
I found no clash between the ticket and the baseline. The time zone constraint and the booking rules support the ticket rather than contradicting it.
Two minimal questions, answered in the IDE: Q-01 (link) gave real options and a default, and the REQ-10 assumption was confirmed. Neither question could be answered from the context pack.
Plain wording. The glossary terms Scheduled, Cancelled, Completed and No-show are used consistently and match the glossary.
